publications.title: An Explainable Approach to Land-Use Classification Using CNN-LSTM and LIME
publications.authors: Md Ashik Ahmmed; Rashel Mahmud Rabbi; Md Shafiuzzaman; Tithi Podder; Most. Tasnina Jaman; Afsana Tasnim
publications.venue: 2025 International Conference on Quantum Photonics, Artificial Intelligence, and Networking (QPAIN), Rangpur, Bangladesh
publications.abstract: The evolution of landscapes has opened the opportunity to utilize previously unused land for various purposes, such as agriculture and urban development. This approach promotes sustainable land management and addresses economic and societal needs. By repurposing land effectively, growth and sustainability in communities can be fostered. This study introduces a hybrid CNN-LSTM model for classifying satellite images in the EuroSAT dataset, encompassing land use categories. The Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)efficiently extracts spatial features, while the Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) captures temporal patterns, achieving an impressive accuracy of 98.30%. Preprocessing includes grayscale conversion, contrast enhancement, and spatial-temporal augmentations to optimize data quality. Explainable AI, implemented via Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME), provides insights into influential features guiding predictions and enhances interpretability.

publications.title: Enhancing Multi-Class Satellite Image Classification with MRCL-ELM: A Hybrid Explainable Deep Learning Approach
publications.authors: Md Ashik Ahmmed, Rashel Mahmud Rabbi, Md Shafiuzzaman, Md. Faysal Ahamed, Md Nahiduzzaman & Muhammad E.H. Chowdhury
publications.abstract: Satellite image classification has many important applications that play a crucial role in the areas of urban planning, agriculture, as well as environmental monitoring. Nevertheless, the high accuracy and interpretability of deep learning models with such complex datasets is still a big challenge. To solve this, a new hybrid deep-learning architecture, MRCL-ELM is proposed to improve the performance of satellite image classification. The model uses EfficientNetB0 as its building block in terms of ability to learn rich features in an efficient manner with optimization of the network depth and size to minimize memory and processing requirements. It combines the Multi-Residual Convolutional (MRC) networks to learn spatial features robustly with the aid of multiple residual paths, in each block, in MRC, to enhance the learning of features and gradient flow. It uses a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) time series modeling layer, and an Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) to quickly and non-iteratively classify data and is therefore lightweight, accurate, and more scalable than other common deep learning architectures. To enhance the interpretability of the proposed model, Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) explains individual predictions by testing small variations in the input, whereas SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) provides feature importance scores throughout the model, along with improving model interpretability and trust. The proposed model provides the highest possible results, with 98.33% accuracy on the EuroSAT dataset and 98.10% accuracy on the UC Merced Land Use dataset, being higher than the use of existing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and transformer-based techniques. The training using fixed random seeds and 5-fold cross-validation is used to ensure robustness. Lastly, MRCL-ELM was implemented as a real-time web-based application and tested with real-life Google Maps imagery, and thus needs real-time, precise, and interpretable satellite image classification for the end-users.

publications.title: HYBSWINEFF: Hybrid CNN-Transformer Fusion for Binary and Multi-Stage Blood Cell Cancer Classification
publications.venue: B.Sc. Thesis, Department of CSE, North Bengal International University
publications.abstract: Early detection and subtyping of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) from peripheral blood smears are vital for timely treatment but remain limited by manual microscopy. To address this, HybSwinEff, a lightweight hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-Transformer architecture, is proposed for automated, interpretable, and multistage ALL classification. The model employs a hierarchical pipeline: first distinguishing benign from malignant cells, then conditionally subtyping malignant cases into Early Pre-B, Pre-B, and Pro-B stages based on morphological features. HybSwinEff combines a pretrained EfficientNetV2-RW-T backbone for local texture extraction with a Swin Transformer Tiny for global context modeling. Features are mean-pooled, projected to a 128-dimensional space, concatenated, and fused through a Residual Fusion Block (RFB) before dual MLP heads for binary and conditional staging tasks. Trained on the Blood Cell Cancer (ALL) and Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) datasets using PyTorch and TIMM pretrained weights, with stratified train-val-test splits, three random seeds (including 42), 5-fold cross validation, label smoothing, balanced class weighting, and heavy augmentations, the model achieves exceptional results: 99.69% binary accuracy and 100% staging accuracy on Blood Cell Cancer, and 100% across all metrics on Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia, outperforming prior state-of-the-art models. Furthermore, LIME visualizations confirm that HybSwinEff focuses on clinically meaningful regions, accurately highlighting malignant blast morphology and typical benign lymphocyte structures, thereby improving interpretability and trust in its diagnostic decisions. With 40.54M parameters, HybSwinEff offers 18% parameter efficiency over similar hybrids and real-time inference (~3.40 ms/image) on GPUs.

projects.title: RentalHub – E-commerce Web App
projects.description: Rental Hub is a modern, responsive web application designed to simplify the process of finding and listing rental properties. The platform enables users to browse available apartments, houses, and rooms through an intuitive interface with detailed property information, pricing, location, and amenities. Property owners can showcase their listings with images and essential details, while prospective tenants can efficiently search and compare rental options based on their preferences. Built with a clean and user-friendly design, Rental Hub focuses on delivering a seamless property discovery experience across desktop and mobile devices. The project demonstrates modern frontend development practices, responsive UI design, and an organized component-based architecture, making it a scalable foundation for future enhancements such as user authentication, real-time messaging, online booking, and secure payment integration.
projects.tech: Django, Tailwind CSS, SQLite, REST API

projects.title: OUR RAJSHAHI – Regional Info Platform
projects.description: Our Rajshahi is a responsive tourism and cultural information platform developed to showcase the rich heritage, history, attractions, education, and lifestyle of Rajshahi, Bangladesh. The website serves as a comprehensive digital guide, enabling visitors to explore famous tourist destinations, historical landmarks, local traditions, educational institutions, cuisine, and essential travel information through an intuitive and visually engaging interface. Designed with a clean, modern, and mobile-friendly layout, the platform enhances user experience by providing well-organized content, interactive navigation, and appealing visual elements. This project demonstrates frontend web development skills, responsive UI/UX design, and effective content organization, while serving as a scalable foundation for future enhancements such as an administrative dashboard, dynamic content management system (CMS), user reviews, event management, multilingual support, and interactive maps.
